projects.title: Environmental Time Series Forecasting
bullets: Aligned public river-level measurement series and identified missing observations as part of a supervised undergraduate independent study in environmental forecasting.
Implemented a seasonal forecasting baseline for the public sensor time series using Python, pandas, and scikit-learn.

projects.title: File-Format Utility Test Coverage
bullets: Measured branch coverage and reproduced reported defects in public file-format utilities for a supervised graduate course project on small open-source libraries.
Wrote unit tests for utility functions using Python and pytest as an assigned contribution to the course project.

research.title: Parsing Utility Test Coverage
bullets: Measured branch coverage in public parsing utilities as a student research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research on small open-source libraries.
Wrote Python unit tests for utility functions in the public parsing utilities, using pytest as part of the supervised research.
